purpose: Second development-informed same-case qualification after R3 exposed that the policy lacked the validator-owned candidate language contract. This run tests interface alignment, V2 counterexample timing, and failed/successful budget auditability; it is not algorithm-effect evidence.
qualification_checks: The independent run audit is valid and persisted model usage is nonzero.
The candidate is validated against the same language contract shown to the model.
Every accepted candidate executes in a distinct fresh checkout and container.
Any second candidate is proposed only after first-candidate internal V2 evidence and normalized constraints are persisted.
Post-episode official evidence is absent from every model request and online state transition.

reporting.network_retry: Only one separately recorded retry after explicit user confirmation of a local network failure.
